slot.brief: Complete hydrolysis products of PCl3/SiCl4-type covalent halides; identify which gives fumes and why.

verdicts.working: PCl₃ + 3H₂O → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl, so the products match (A).

working:
PCl$_3$ + 3 H$_2$O → H$_3$PO$_3$ + 3 HCl. The HCl gas produces dense white fumes in moist air.

Independent check: PCl₃ + 3H₂O → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl, so the products match (A).
solution:
On complete hydrolysis, phosphorus trichloride forms phosphorous acid and hydrochloric acid:
$$\mathrm{PCl_3 + 3H_2O \rightarrow H_3PO_3 + 3HCl}$$

draft.working: PCl$_3$ + 3 H$_2$O → H$_3$PO$_3$ + 3 HCl. The HCl gas produces dense white fumes in moist air.
draft.distractor_notes: B: PCl₅ gives phosphoric acid, but PCl₃ gives phosphorous acid; C and D: no Cl₂ is formed, hydrolysis gives HCl.
